summary: Aion Ray7 kicks off presales with Huawei brake-by-wire; XPeng MONA L05 and BYD Sea Lion 08 lead a wave of new launches; BMW's Gen6 large cylindrical battery enters mass production in China for the first time; China-EU tensions heat up over hybrids.

articles.title: Aion Ray7 Opens Pre-Sales From CNY 128,800, Debuting Huawei Brake-by-Wire
articles.summary: Aion Ray7 has launched pre-sales starting at CNY 128,800, debuting Huawei's brake-by-wire system in a push to compete on both smart features and value.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, Aion has officially opened pre-sales for its all-new Ray7 model, with a starting price of CNY 128,800. The car's biggest highlight is the first-ever integration of Huawei's brake-by-wire system in this price segment. Compared with conventional hydraulic braking, brake-by-wire offers clear advantages in response speed, energy recovery efficiency and coordination with intelligent driving functions, and is widely seen by the industry as a key sign of smart chassis technology filtering down to mainstream price points. Aion's decision to equip a vehicle in the 120,000-yuan class with Huawei's brake-by-wire solution reflects a strategy of using technology transfer to win market share. Pre-sale details show the new model is taking an aggressive approach to smart features, targeting younger buyers seeking a tech-forward experience. With competition in the A+ NEV segment intensifying, the Ray7's pricing and technology combination puts direct pressure on rivals such as BYD and Geely Galaxy in the same price bracket.
articles.impact: The move of Huawei brake-by-wire technology into the 120,000-yuan price tier could accelerate the adoption of smart chassis technology and reset the competitive tech bar for A+ class NEVs.

articles.title: XPeng MONA L05 Opens Pre-Sales From CNY 169,800, Targets Young Buyers With Five-Seat Layout
articles.summary: XPeng's MONA L05 starts pre-sales at CNY 169,800, offering both battery-electric and range-extended powertrains in a large five-seat format.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that the L05, the second mass-production model in XPeng's MONA series, has officially entered pre-sales with a starting price of CNY 169,800. Positioned as a large five-seat SUV/sedan aimed at younger buyers, the car's standout feature is the availability of both battery-electric and range-extended versions to suit different use cases. The addition of the range-extended variant marks the first time the MONA lineup covers customers seeking freedom from range anxiety, and represents a strategic expansion of XPeng's powertrain portfolio. The MONA L05 continues the series' emphasis on value for money and design flair, with cabin space and comfort repeatedly highlighted by the automaker. Given MONA's prior market performance, the L05 is seen as a key volume driver for the series and an important move for XPeng to cement its footing in the mainstream CNY 150,000-200,000 price band.
articles.impact: The dual powertrain strategy closes a gap in XPeng's product portfolio and directly challenges benchmarks such as the BYD Song Plus and Deepal S07 in the mainstream family-car market.

articles.title: BYD Sea Lion 08 Gets Comprehensive Exterior and Interior Overhaul as 8-Series Flagship SUV Nears Launch
articles.summary: BYD's flagship 8-series SUV Sea Lion 08 undergoes a major exterior redesign based on user feedback and a more luxurious interior, signaling a push into the premium market.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports new details emerging on BYD's Ocean Network flagship SUV, the Sea Lion 08. As the flagship SUV within BYD's 8-series lineup, the Sea Lion 08 is said to have incorporated extensive customer feedback into its exterior design — described by the company as "listening to advice" — while the interior has received targeted upgrades in luxury and refinement. The Sea Lion 08 carries BYD's ambition to compete at higher price points in the mid-to-large SUV segment, taking on popular flagships such as the Aito M9 and Li Auto L9. BYD has enjoyed strong sales in the CNY 200,000-300,000 range through its parallel Ocean and Dynasty networks, but still needs products with genuine brand-premium capability to support its push above CNY 300,000. The Sea Lion 08's design upgrades are a deliberate part of BYD's strategy to elevate its product image and raise its price ceiling.
articles.impact: The Sea Lion 08 is a key model in BYD's bid for the premium flagship SUV segment and is expected to lift the brand's overall pricing power.

articles.title: All-New Voyager 7 Launches With Gasoline Variant From CNY 125,000, Emphasizes Luxurious Cabin
articles.summary: The all-new Voyager 7 debuts with a gasoline version priced from CNY 125,000, featuring more upscale styling and a major upgrade in cabin comfort.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that the all-new Voyager 7 has officially gone on sale, with the gasoline-powered variant starting at CNY 125,000. The new model moves its design language in a more premium direction while placing special emphasis on cabin comfort, with upgrades across seating, noise insulation and interior materials. The CNY 125,000 starting price for the gasoline version suggests that automakers are still committed to offering high-value options for internal-combustion customers amid the surge in new energy vehicles. The Voyager 7's launch also underscores the continued heat in the boxy, rugged-style SUV niche, where manufacturers are ramping up investment. By combining a more luxurious design with a comfort-focused cabin, the new model seeks a balance between hardcore off-road appeal and urban family practicality, targeting buyers who want a distinctive look without compromising daily driving quality.
articles.impact: In an SUV market increasingly dominated by new energy vehicles, the gasoline-powered Voyager 7 at CNY 125,000 defends the traditional powertrain segment and intensifies competition in the boxy-SUV category.

articles.title: Stelato Brake-Pedal Scandal Rages On as SAIC-Volkswagen publicly Mocks Safety Concerns
articles.summary: The Stelato brake-pedal controversy continues to escalate, with SAIC-Volkswagen taking a public dig that reignites debate over braking safety.
articles.detail: According to Sogou News, the online controversy over the brake pedal in Stelato models continues to escalate. SAIC-Volkswagen recently weighed in with a public remark widely seen as a veiled jab, stating that a brake pedal is "not a soft-shelled crab" — a phrase that has once again turned industry attention toward braking system safety. The so-called "pedal gate" scandal began when some users questioned the structure and safety of the brake pedal in Stelato vehicles, sparking widespread discussion on social media and across automotive circles. SAIC-Volkswagen's intervention is viewed as a public challenge from a traditional joint-venture brand to the safety credentials of a new-energy startup. The episode reflects a broader reality: as new energy and smart vehicles advance rapidly, consumers are paying closer attention to the reliability of basic safety components such as brakes and chassis systems, and any related doubt can quickly escalate into a brand-trust crisis.
articles.impact: The braking safety dispute has escalated into a public clash between brands, highlighting that basic safety components remain a vulnerability in the reputation of new energy vehicle makers.

articles.title: New Tesla Roadster Unveiled, Flying Concept Sparks Buzz
articles.summary: Tesla's new Roadster made its official debut, with the company hinting at a flying capability, pushing both performance and imagination to the limit.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that Tesla has officially unveiled its next-generation Roadster, with official messaging even including references to a flying capability, triggering widespread discussion across the industry and among consumers. As the latest iteration in the Roadster lineup, the new car upholds the series' tradition of positioning itself as a supercar and showcasing the brand's performance ceiling. The Roadster has faced repeated controversy over delayed deliveries, and this unveiling is seen as a key move by Tesla to redefine its brand image and demonstrate its frontier technology reserves. While the flying concept remains closer to a technical vision than a production-ready feature, the signal it sends is worth watching — Tesla is extending its electrification advantage toward more extreme performance and mobility formats. Should part of these features eventually come to market, the impact on the global supercar and premium EV landscape would be profound.
articles.impact: The Roadster symbolizes Tesla's technological peak; its debut helps reshape the brand image and shows the industry the performance boundaries of electric supercars.

articles.title: BMW EV Claims 1,213 km Range, Reshaping Industry Expectations
articles.summary: A BMW electric model claims a range of 1,213 km, sparking industry-wide debate over the figure's real-world accuracy.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that a new BMW electric vehicle claims a range of up to 1,213 kilometers, drawing wide attention and debate across the industry. If that figure can be delivered in real-world driving, it would rank among the top levels for production EVs today and substantially ease consumers' range anxiety. Industry analysts say the result is closely tied to battery technology, energy management strategies and lightweight design on BMW's Neue Klasse platform. However, testing standards, road conditions and driving habits have a major impact on actual range, and consumers will still need to wait for third-party test data from real-world scenarios. Regardless of the final measured outcome, BMW has already raised the EV range ceiling once again, creating new competitive pressure on battery and efficiency R&D across the industry.
articles.impact: If confirmed, a 1,213 km range would reset the EV benchmark and force rivals to accelerate battery and efficiency innovation.

articles.title: Large Cylindrical Battery Enters First Domestic Mass Production, BMW Neue Klasse Hits the Fast Lane
articles.summary: Large cylindrical batteries have achieved their first mass production in China, noticeably accelerating the rollout of BMW's Neue Klasse models.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto reports that large cylindrical batteries have entered mass production in China for the first time, a breakthrough that puts the localization of BMW's Neue Klasse models into fast-forward. Compared with conventional prismatic cells, large cylindrical batteries offer combined advantages in energy density, fast-charging performance, structural strength and cost control, and are widely regarded by the industry as one of the key technical routes for the next generation of power batteries. BMW's Neue Klasse platform is the core vehicle of the company's electrification strategy, demanding extremely high standards in battery performance and safety. The domestic production of large cylindrical batteries not only marks major progress in localizing BMW's supply chain in China, but also drives the domestic battery industry chain toward high-end technical routes. For domestic battery suppliers, entering the mass-production stage for large cylindrical cells will become a new competitive threshold.
articles.impact: Local mass production of large cylindrical batteries is a milestone for power battery technology, set to support BMW's Neue Klasse rollout in China and drive industry-chain upgrades.

articles.title: China and EU Propose Three Principles for Hybrids, Raising Stakes in Global Powertrain Battle
articles.summary: China and the EU have put forward three principles for hybrid vehicles, making the positioning and policy direction of hybrid technology a focal point of global competition.
articles.detail: Recent news analysis shows that China and the European Union have proposed three principles for the development of hybrid electric vehicles, sparking broad industry debate over the role of hybrid technology and future policy direction. As a key transitional path from internal combustion engines to full electrification, hybrids have long received unequal policy treatment in the two markets. Beijing stresses the practical value of hybrids during the carbon-reduction transition, while Brussels is more concerned with their positioning under carbon emission regulations and market access rules. The introduction of the three principles signals an effort by both sides to establish a framework of rules that can be discussed and coordinated. This competition directly affects the product strategies of Chinese automakers expanding into Europe, the product planning of joint ventures in China, and investment directions across the global supply chain. For carmakers pursuing both hybrids and battery-electric vehicles, any easing or tightening of policy will significantly alter the economics of their product portfolios.
articles.impact: The China-EU hybrid policy contest will directly shape Chinese automakers' overseas expansion paths and joint-venture product lineups in China, making it a critical policy variable for the industry to watch.

articles.title: Interview with Jiang Ping: No Safety Tiering — Changan Wants Safety Tech for All
articles.summary: Changan executive Jiang Ping said in an interview that the company will not tier safety features, but will make safety technology a universally available standard.
articles.detail: NetEase Auto interviewed Changan Automobile executive Jiang Ping. During the interview, Jiang made clear that Changan will not differentiate safety features across trim levels, and will instead make safety a universal, standard feature accessible to buyers across all price segments. The remarks stand in contrast to the common industry practice of tiering active and safety systems by model grade. Jiang emphasized that safety is the bottom line of any vehicle product and should not be an exclusive label for higher trims. By championing universal safety as a brand proposition, Changan is effectively trying to build a differentiated competitive edge on safety value amid an intensifying industry price war. With consumers increasingly focused on genuine product capability rather than price alone, this strategy could earn Changan more durable user trust.
articles.impact: Changan's push to make safety a universal standard could build a differentiation barrier in the price war and pressure the industry to abandon tiered safety configurations.

articles.title: Drive-by-Wire Chassis Pushes Downmarket; Smart Braking Eyes Next Competitive Battleground
articles.summary: Huawei's brake-by-wire system debuts on the 120,000-yuan Aion Ray7, signaling that drive-by-wire chassis tech is set to spread rapidly into the mainstream market.
articles.detail: Aion Ray7 brings Huawei's brake-by-wire system to a presale price starting at 128,800 yuan — a move whose industry significance far outweighs its impact on a single model. Brake-by-wire is a core component of the drive-by-wire chassis and until now was largely reserved for premium smart EVs priced above 300,000 yuan. With tech companies such as Huawei driving technology transfer and cost reduction at scale, drive-by-wire chassis systems are moving quickly into mainstream price bands. Within two years, brake-by-wire and steer-by-wire setups on new energy vehicles in the 150,000-yuan segment are expected to become commonplace, spurring an overall upgrade of the execution layer in intelligent driving. For automakers, the choice between in-house development and suppliers of drive-by-wire chassis will directly shape the ceiling of their smart-driving capabilities; for consumers, brake response, energy-recovery efficiency and the intelligent-driving experience will see tangible gains. Drive-by-wire chassis could emerge as a new dividing line in the new energy vehicle race of 2027.
articles.impact: As drive-by-wire technology filters down to mainstream price bands, the entire intelligent-driving execution layer will be upgraded, reshaping the technical competition in the 150,000-yuan vehicle segment.

articles.title: BYD's Dahan Arrives as Flagship Luxury Segment Enters Multi-Brand Melee
articles.summary: BYD's Dahan targets luxury intelligence and flagship-level comfort, and together with the Sea Lion 08, BYD is making an all-out push into the premium market.
articles.detail: According to NetEase Auto, BYD has unveiled the Dahan model, officially described as fully loaded with luxury and intelligence and offering more than flagship-level comfort, directly challenging the high-end luxury market. Combined with the Sea Lion 08 flagship SUV revealed around the same time, BYD is assembling a dual-flagship premium product matrix spanning both sedans and SUVs. The layout shows BYD is no longer content with scale leadership alone, but aims to build genuine brand premium in the market above 300,000 yuan. Yet competition in the high-end arena is intensifying, with Aito, Li Auto, Nio and traditional luxury brands all ramping up investment. Whether BYD's blend of luxury and intelligence can win over premium consumers will hinge on its overall delivery in smart cockpit, intelligent-driving experience and service systems. Over the next year, the market performance of BYD's flagship lineup will be a key indicator of how far Chinese brands are progressing upmarket.
articles.impact: BYD's dual-flagship strategy accelerates its premium push, but also means head-to-head competition with Aito, Li Auto and the BBA brands is entering a white-hot phase.
